apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: Route cards now show ICAO codes, and tapping a search result opens live arrivals and departures with a Move button.
